title: Bi-modal MvG conductivity representation
question: Can model-3 conductivity be represented independently in log(K) over the same bounded unsaturated domain without pathological dry-tail refinement?
representation: independent adaptive linear interpolation of log(K) over x=log10(-h)
decision_rule: PASS only if all three preregistered parameterizations reach abs(logK) <= 1e-3 on independent dense validation without recursion pathology or more than 500 support points. If dry-tail pathology appears, stop rather than inventing a posthoc floor.
